title: Run record and reports.md conflict when merging a task branch into main
body: What happened: merging the task branch into main failed with CONFLICT (content) in .warden/reports.md, because both main and the branch had changed it (warden upgrade and report commits on main, a reports commit on the branch). Expected: a ship merge with no conflict in a warden-generated file. Steps: start a run in a worktree, commit warden reports on the branch, then on main run warden upgrade --done and warden report --status --write and commit, then git merge --no-ff the branch. Evidence: Auto-merging .warden/reports.md / CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in .warden/reports.md. Workaround: git checkout --ours, then warden report --status --write.
note: Accepted. Planned for a coming release.
